papers.title_en: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team, Yuechen Luo, Chong He, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Jingkai Wang, Menglun Su, Jiaxin Liu, Shengyin Jiang, Zhiyi Lai, Long Chen, Longlong Wang, Liang Hu, Haochen Liu, Yuncheng Jiang, Hongwei Xie, Jieming Cui, Hanbing Li, Junjie Huang, Zhixiang Duan, Hexin Zhang, Weixiang Liang, Ying Gong, Yuhan Wang, Yong Pan, Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Ken Deng, Kun Ma, Fuxi Wen, Zhi-xin Yang, Hangjun Ye
papers.evidence: 统一协调机器人导航与操控的具身智能体
papers.tldr: 机器人要可靠完成长程任务，必须协调操控与导航技能、持续跟踪进度，并能根据反馈从失败中恢复；单一专才策略难以胜任，而强大的多模态智能体又往往推理和执行成本较高。OmniBrain-0以共享高层决策模型统一任务理解、规划、进度追踪和恢复，结合具身预训练、领域专家蒸馏、多教师在线策略蒸馏，以及基于执行证据改进规则和轨迹的递归自我改进。模型在五项仿真基准和多种真实操控任务中取得较强跨领域表现，推理与执行开销显著低于闭源教师。该方法将多领域能力整合进轻量决策模型，展示了高效迁移与统一具身智能的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

papers.title_en: GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT
papers.authors: Muyeol Sung, Jangwon Kim, Jongwoo Lim
papers.evidence: 保持几何精度的VGGT加速改进
papers.tldr: 多视图几何模型VGGT可一次前向预测相机参数、深度图与点图，但全局注意力随帧数呈二次增长，长序列推理成本高；现有免训练令牌合并虽能提速，却常损害几何精度。GPA-VGGT在早期块以带共享跨帧键值的帧注意力替代全局注意力，后续仅合并键和值并保留全部查询，同时校正注意力质量、压缩匹配维度。实验显示其速度提升与既有方法相当，位姿AUC@3保留VGGT的99%以上，为高效且精准的多视角估计提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward geometry models such as VGGT recover camera parameters, depth maps, and point maps from one to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, making them powerful backbones for multi-view 3D perception. However, VGGT's global attention is quadratic in the number of frames and dominates end-to-end runtime on long sequences, which has motivated a range of training-free efficiency methods such as token merging. These methods, however, come with a drop in accuracy that makes them hard to use in place of VGGT. We propose GPA-VGGT, a training-free acceleration method that replaces global attention in early blocks with frame attention augmented by a shared cross-frame K/V set. In the remaining blocks, we merge only keys and values while preserving all queries, restore the attention mass of the tokens each merged key represents, and randomly project the matching metric to 128 dimensions to reduce matching cost. Across diverse multi-view geometry tasks, GPA-VGGT provides training-free acceleration at speedups comparable to prior work while preserving the information required for precise geometric estimation, retaining over 99% of VGGT's pose accuracy under AUC@3.

papers.title_en: LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM
papers.authors: Da Li, Yihan Zang, Ivan Viola, Zeyu Wang, Dominik Engel
papers.evidence: 结合单目深度估计、相机位姿跟踪与高斯场景重建
papers.tldr: 单目RGB高斯泼溅SLAM需要在有限优化预算下兼顾重建质量与实时相机跟踪，但仅靠学习式位姿预测精度受限。LingGS将冻结的流式三维基础模型作为虚拟RGB-D传感器估计深度，并以特征重投影几何求解器显式跟踪相机，再由流式高斯建图器融合观测。实验显示，该设计在室内外数据上提升重建质量，单张RTX 4090约达7帧/秒，吞吐量为对比系统的2至3倍。结果表明，显式几何跟踪可有效补足学习几何先验，并适用于多种流式几何骨干。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.

papers.title_en: Learning to Code the World: Harness Evolution for Compositional 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Haoyu Yao, Chenguo Lin, Ruize Du, Yadong Mu
papers.evidence: 图像到组合式三维重建及层级场景建模
papers.tldr: 从真实图像重建可编辑且结构合理的三维场景，需要同时处理几何、物体组成和空间关系，给模型带来较大挑战。SceneEvolve将场景表示为可执行代码，以语义动作接口组合参数化图元，并依据开发集反馈迭代改进模型周边的重建流程。优化时模型参数、动作语义和执行后端保持不变，因此所得流程可用于未见场景，无须更新参数或教师协助。在三类数据集上，Qwen3.8-27B的四项指标均提升，推理时间减少47%；其重建质量较GPT-5.6-Sol高32.3%，部署成本降低59.8%，流程也能迁移至Kimi-K3。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.

papers.title_en: World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer
papers.authors: Guoning Wu, Zijian Cai, Yuhang Zhang, Ying Liu, Yongbin Zheng
papers.evidence: 具身机器人通过共享空间状态整合感知并预测各自动作
papers.tldr: 多机器人控制需要融合分布式相机视角，并为不同机器人分别预测动作；单机器人模型难以满足这一需求，简单合并视角也不能建立空间对应。World Dreamer v5-lite以共享工作空间状态整合经标定的视觉特征，再用机器人专属查询读取状态、交换位姿信息，同时保持动作流彼此独立。模型在RoboFactory平均成功率达74.0%，领先最强基线23.7个百分点；四项真实机器人任务平均达78.8%，在RoboCasa365达58.08%。结果表明，共享空间表征有望提升多机器人协作控制能力。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

papers.title_en: E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling
papers.authors: X-Era AI Lab Team, :, Jianhao Lai, Zhihao Zhan, Zhiquan Liao, Qichang Li, Shubin Chen, Zhiyuan Liu, Hongsen Lei, Jianman Lin, Xiaoxin Lin, Ke Gong, Baiyue Gu, Shiming Chen, Junlin He, Longqi Yang, Junrong Xiao, Haolin Luo, Xiaojuan Su, Jianfeng Li, Yu Luo, Xu Sun, Likui Zhang, Jusheng Zhang, Qinhan Lyu, Tianshui Chen, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang
papers.evidence: 以三维几何为核心的机器人世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 当前世界-动作模型多以视频模型或视觉语言模型为主干，三维几何常仅作辅助，难以原生刻画空间动态。E0.5以三维基础模型为核心，同时预测未来三维状态与机器人动作，将几何作为世界建模和动作生成的共同表征。它在RoboTwin 2.0无具身预训练下取得干净与随机设置89.90%和50.09%的成功率；用逾16万条轨迹预训练后，Piper与H1真实操作成功率分别提升约15和7个百分点。结果显示，几何原生基础有助于学习交互并迁移至真实操控。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models. Even when geometric features extracted by 3D models such as VGGT are incorporated, they are typically passed into a video model or VLM that serves as the primary backbone, leaving 3D geometry as an auxiliary input or prediction target rather than the native foundation for world modeling. We present E0.5, a geometry-native world-action model built directly on 3D foundation models. E0.5 introduces two key innovations. First, it adopts a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone, making 3D geometry the native representation for both world modeling and action prediction. Second, it explicitly predicts future 3D states together with actions, enabling the model to capture geometric world dynamics beyond action-only modeling or future video prediction. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 first demonstrate the effectiveness of E0.5 without embodied-data pretraining, achieving success rates of 89.90\% and 50.09\% under clean and randomized settings, respectively. Building on these results, we further pretrain E0.5 on more than 160k robot trajectories from AgiBotWorld-Beta, jointly learning robot actions and future geometry within the pretrained 3D foundation. This embodied pretraining improves mean real-world manipulation success rates by approximately 15 and 7 percentage points on AgileX Piper and Zerith H1, respectively. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of geometry-native foundations to acquire robot interaction knowledge and transfer it to physical manipulation. E0.5 embodies this geometry-native approach as a member of the VWA family of world-action models.

papers.title_en: HoloRecon: Incremental Reconstruction of Long-Range Panoramas with Global Consistency
papers.authors: Zhuoxiao Li, Xinyi Liu, Hongye Hou, Jing OU, Kang Du, Shuai Zhang, Dongli Wu, Taoyu Wu, Siyuan Feng, Xiaohui Zhu, Wufan Zhao
papers.evidence: 结合前馈局部几何重建与全局相机一致性约束
papers.tldr: 长序列全景重建既要恢复细致几何，也要保证相隔较远的回访区域拥有一致相机位姿；重复建筑与局部重叠不足令匹配困难，漂移难以消除。HoloRecon结合ORB稀疏全景跟踪和微调前馈模型的局部几何预测，通过深度校准及三维特征匹配验证建立远距离约束，再优化全局位姿图并更新稠密几何。在含重复建筑及大小回环的七场景PanoRecon基准上，它取得最低平均绝对轨迹误差和较高F1分数。该工作提供长序列全景重建框架及带参考位姿、激光雷达几何的评测基准。
papers.abstract_en: Long-sequence panoramic reconstruction requires detailed scene geometry and globally consistent camera poses across distant revisits. Panoramic SLAM and incremental SfM rely on feature correspondences, but repeated, similar structures and small partial overlap make reliable long-range connections difficult to establish, leaving accumulated drift unresolved. Feed-forward models offer detailed local geometry, but their high computational costs limit inference window size, necessitating additional constraints for global consistency. This motivates combining continuous feature-based tracking and sparse mapping with rapid, high-quality local reconstruction from feed-forward models to achieve accurate localization and globally consistent dense mapping over long sequences. We therefore propose a panoramic reconstruction framework that couples an ORB-based sparse panoramic mapping frontend with a fine-tuned feed-forward model. Our key insight is that predicted local geometry enables 3D verification of feature matches across distant revisits, yielding long-range camera constraints even between regions. We calibrate predicted depths with sparse landmarks and use verified connections to optimize the global pose graph, updating dense geometry with the corrected camera poses. We also introduce PanoRecon, a seven-scene benchmark with repetitive architecture, large and small loops, and reference camera poses and LiDAR geometry for evaluating global consistency. Our method achieves the lowest mean absolute trajectory error and high F-1 Score among the evaluated methods. Project Page:https://zhuoxiaoli.github.io/HoloRecon_page/

papers.title_en: SplatScout: Query-Driven Part-Level Referring Segmentation in Gaussian Scenes
papers.authors: Yihan Zang, Da Li, Shinkyu Park, Ivan Viola, Dominik Engel
papers.evidence: 在三维高斯场景中进行部件级指代分割
papers.tldr: 高斯场景中的指代分割多聚焦完整物体，并依赖预先生成的候选，容易漏掉可作为目标或识别线索的细粒度部件。SplatScout将感知过程交由视觉语言模型主动控制，通过选择视角、指挥分割并检查三维渲染结果形成闭环迭代。论文构建含261条人工核验查询、覆盖12个ScanNet++场景的部件级基准，取得0.538 mIoU，并在四个既有基准上得分更高。结果表明，交互式反馈有助于细粒度理解与指代分割。
papers.abstract_en: Existing referring segmentation methods on Gaussian scenes primarily target whole objects, relying on segmenter-generated candidates from which a vision-language model (VLM) selects. Such predetermined fixed candidates may omit fine-grained parts needed as targets or cues for identifying objects. We introduce SplatScout, a query-driven, closed-loop approach that places perception under VLM control. The model actively selects views, directs segmentation, and inspects rendered 3D results to refine its predictions. For part-level evaluation, we introduce PartRef-ScanNet++, comprising 261 manually verified queries across 12 ScanNet++ scenes with mesh-derived ground truth. On PartRef-ScanNet++, SplatScout achieves 0.538 mIoU, substantially outperforming existing methods. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of iterative refinement, while comparisons across VLM backbones highlight the importance of effective tool-feedback utilization. SplatScout also achieves higher scores on four existing referring benchmarks. Code and the PartRef-ScanNet++ benchmark are available at https://github.com/kaust-violab/SplatScout.

papers.title_en: Ego-CEVR: Learning Cross-Embodiment Visual Representations from Human Egocentric Videos
papers.authors: Keru Zhou, Zhirui Fang, Xinrun Xu, Yaopeng Lou, Zeyuan He, Zihao Zhu, Xinze Niu, Chen Wang, Tianfu Li, Samith Va, Bin Qian, Junwei Li, Wenjia Ding, Yicheng Xu, Chang Zhou, Ziwei Wang, Li Liu, Xiu Li, Maoqing Yao
papers.evidence: 从人类第一人称视频学习用于机器人操作的跨具身视觉表示
papers.tldr: 具身机器人操作需要从视觉中理解任务全局进展，也需要识别局部动作对齐与接触线索；人类第一视角视频规模大、语境丰富，却通常缺乏精细动作标注。Ego-CEVR以分层表征应对这一差异：全局模块通过未来预测学习物体关系、任务状态和时间进度，交互模块结合全局语境与机器人动作监督学习局部线索。两个模块通过独立残差路径向策略提供信息，保留任务语境和执行细节。该框架还支持用人类及多种机器人视频独立预训练全局模块，无需动作标签或配对腕部观测，为跨具身学习提供数据原生方案。
papers.abstract_en: As egocentric video becomes increasingly available for embodied learning, an important research question is how to turn this low-cost, scalable source of data into robot manipulation capabilities. Egocentric videos naturally provide rich context for high-level task understanding, while real-robot demonstrations with wrist observations and action annotations provide supervision for fine-grained action alignment. We present Ego-CEVR, a data-native framework for hierarchical visual representation learning that assigns distinct learning objectives to global and interaction representations. The global module learns object relations, task state, and temporal progress through future prediction on egocentric video. The Interaction module interprets wrist observations in global context and learns local alignment and contact cues through robot action supervision. Separate residual paths expose both representations to the action policy, preserving direct access to task context alongside fine-grained execution information. Ego-CEVR supports independent pretraining of its global video module on large-scale human egocentric videos and videos from diverse robot embodiments, without requiring robot action labels or paired wrist observations.

papers.title_en: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
papers.authors: Jonas Eschmann, Giuseppe Loianno
papers.evidence: 无人机模拟器生成深度、分割、法线等具身感知数据
papers.tldr: 视觉无人机控制依赖大量仿真训练，但现有批量四旋翼模拟器难以同时满足高吞吐与真实渲染需求，制约了策略训练和仿真到现实迁移。HyperDrone结合优化的多旋翼动力学与可在GPU运行的HyperLux光追引擎，支持多种图形后端及RGB、深度、分割等观测，并可配置反射、真实光照和运动模糊。论文报告其较现有先进批量模拟器快逾20倍，高保真场景下消费级GPU可达百万帧每秒。作者用纯仿真训练视觉偏航控制策略，并将其迁移至搭载相机的Crazyflie，展示了高速、高保真仿真对真实无人机应用的价值。
papers.abstract_en: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the merits of HyperDrone by training a vision-based yaw-control policy purely in simulation and transferring it to a real small-scale quadrotor (Crazyflie) with a camera, running completely onboard.

papers.title_en: Thermal-Headroom Routing for Efficient Robot Perception in Extreme Heat
papers.authors: Sparsh Roy, Kevin Zhou, Arhaan Shah, Shreyan Garg, Vihaan Joshi-Apte, Maxim Kudryashov, Nanda Cheruvanthala
papers.evidence: 面向机器人感知的检测配置选择与热管理
papers.tldr: 高环境温度可能导致处理器热降频，使机器人感知难以兼顾推理时延与能耗，尤其容易错过任务截止时间。论文提出热余量路由，利用闭式 RC 热模型预测温度，并避开预计触发降频的 YOLO11 配置。跨七条真实感知轨迹的仿真显示，在 45–55°C 且截止时间紧迫时，策略消除降频，相比延迟感知路由降低漏期率并减少准时帧能耗。研究说明，热预测在环境或热参数变化时更有价值，也界定了静态策略可匹敌的适用条件。
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive robot perception systems must balance detector accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption, particularly when high ambient temperatures cause processors to thermally throttle. We propose Thermal-Headroom Routing (THR), a lightweight model-selection policy that forecasts processor temperature using a closed-form RC thermal model and excludes detector configurations predicted to cross a throttling threshold. We evaluate THR with four YOLO11 configurations across seven real-world perception traces, eight ambient temperatures, and 20 randomized seeds, comparing it with latency-aware routing, fixed-threshold thermostats, duty caps, and a matched-compute-budget control. At ambient temperatures of 45-55 degrees C and a tight inference deadline, THR eliminates throttling in simulation, reduces deadline misses by 3.9-7.5 percentage points, and reduces energy per on-time frame by approximately 12-13% relative to a latency-belief router. A separate experiment using deadline-paced, nonoverlapping frame execution yields miss-rate reductions of 6.2-9.5 percentage points. A tuned thermostat or duty cap can match THR at a fixed operating point; predictive routing is most useful when ambient conditions or calibrated thermal parameters differ from those used to tune static policies. Measurements on an Apple M5 support the single-node heating approximation but do not validate hardware throttling. The results characterize the conditions under which thermal forecasting improves the efficiency and timeliness of resource-constrained robot perception.

papers.title_en: OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation
papers.authors: Shuyang Yu, Haibo Qin, Shaohan Hu, Wei Shan, Xiaoqing Guan, You Wang, Guang Li
papers.evidence: 从单张图像预测室内三维占据几何与开放词汇语义
papers.tldr: 室内单目占据预测需从单张RGB图像恢复三维几何与语义，但既有方法受限于预定义类别，难以识别多样、细粒度及未见物体。OVM-Occ采用语言嵌入高斯作为场景表示，以几何感知可变形注意力优化语义特征，并利用实例级视觉语言教师和解耦蒸馏协调几何与语义学习。作者还构建OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica基准。实验中，该方法在Occ-ScanNet较此前最佳方法提升12.2 mIoU和0.6 IoU，并在新评测协议下保持优势，推动室内占据预测走向开放词汇泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

papers.title_en: Environment Edits as a Corrective Signal for Reward Learning
papers.authors: Isaac Ngui, Courtney McBeth, Nancy M. Amato
papers.evidence: 利用环境交互反馈学习机器人偏好
papers.tldr: 机器人纠正可用于调整行为，但一次动作往往同时改变多个特征，也难以表达对物体属性及物体间关系的偏好。本文提出环境编辑作为补充反馈：保持机器人运动不变，由人移动场景中的物体，使编辑提供更明确的偏好线索。方法FERRET联合学习机器人纠正与环境编辑轨迹中的偏好。实验表明，环境编辑能消歧特征，并学到仅凭机器人纠正无法获得的偏好，拓展了奖励学习的反馈形式。
papers.abstract_en: Robot corrections allow people to adjust a robot's behavior, but a single correction changes many features. Also, preferences about object attributes and relationships between objects cannot be expressed by moving the robot. We propose environment edits as a complementary form of feedback. The robot's motion is held constant as the human edits the scene, so the only explanation for the edit is the moved object. We introduce Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces (FERRET), which learns preferences from both robot and environment corrections. We show that environment edits are able to disambiguate features and learn preferences that robot corrections alone cannot.

papers.title_en: SAGE: Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts for Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Tomoyasu Shimada, Kazuhiko Murasaki, Shoichiro Takeda, Shogo Sato, Riku Inoue, Toshihiko Nishimura, Ryuichi Tanida
papers.evidence: 语义增强点云配准以支持场景重建
papers.tldr: 点云配准需要对齐仅部分重叠的场景，低重叠时，电视柜与桌角、椅腿与桌腿等几何相似结构易被错误对应。SAGE将冻结的预训练点云语义表征融入配准，无需增加传感器或微调语义编码器，并用语义引导的专家混合结构按语义路由，让专家适配不同语义—几何模式。结合结构感知估计器，SAGE在3DLoMatch取得最高配准召回率，在3DMatch保持竞争力；迭代次数相同时，两项基准的内点率与召回率均最高。结果表明，冻结语义信息可有效消解低重叠配准中的几何歧义。
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud registration is an essential task for scene reconstruction, requiring the alignment of partially overlapping point clouds. Under low-overlap conditions, this task remains challenging because existing geometry-only methods cannot distinguish geometrically similar but semantically distinct structures (e.g., TV corners vs. desk corners and chair legs vs. table legs), resulting in incorrect correspondences. To address this geometric ambiguity, we present Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts (SAGE), which integrates frozen pre-trained point cloud semantic representations into the registration pipeline without requiring additional sensors or fine-tuning the semantic encoder. To effectively leverage these semantic distinctions, SAGE employs a Semantic-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) architecture. Through semantic-aware routing, SG-MoE enables each expert to specialize in distinct semantic-geometric patterns, reducing mismatches that confound geometry-only methods. With a structure-aware estimator, SAGE achieves the highest registration recall on 3DLoMatch while remaining competitive on 3DMatch. When evaluated with the same number of refinement iterations, SAGE further achieves the highest inlier ratio and registration recall on both benchmarks. These results indicate that frozen semantic representations provide effective cues for resolving geometric ambiguity in low-overlap registration.

papers.title_en: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
papers.authors: Bohua Wang, Congyang Zhao, Tianxiong Lv, Chenxu Zhao, He Zheng, Hangqi Fan, Leigang Luo, Zhihao Liao, Yihong Guo, Yang Cai
papers.evidence: 从单幅图像预测包含几何和语义的三维占据场
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维占据预测希望在统一体素网格中表达场景几何与语义，但高斯尺度膨胀、过度重叠会扭曲占据，跨类别语义混合也会削弱预测。针对室内单张RGB图像，GCSR-OCC提出几何校准与多模态查询条件语义路由：EC-G2O以核质量归一化、p范数和可学习增益抑制局部证据过量，MM-QGSR则按文本查询匹配高斯语义模式并路由证据到体素。无需三维语义标注，该方法在Occ-ScanNet取得63.31%几何IoU和27.44%语义mIoU，同时将几何聚合延迟从19.76毫秒降至12.88毫秒，兼顾预测质量与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: Generalizable Target-Less Joint Intrinsic-Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Pixel-Point Correspondences
papers.authors: Simon Bultmann, Daniele Cattaneo, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 直接联合估计相机内参、畸变及相机与激光雷达外参。
papers.tldr: 相机与激光雷达的准确标定是多模态机器人感知的基础，但现有深度对应式无靶标方法通常要求相机内参已知、图像经过校正。本文将像素—点对应学习推广到原始相机，通过合成增强处理内参与畸变，并在迭代优化中联合估计内参、畸变和传感器外参。在未见过的KITTI配置及三种真实机器人平台上进行零样本测试，结果显示外参精度优于依赖预标定相机的对应方法，同时可恢复准确内参。该框架降低了标定前置条件，提升了跨设备应用能力。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate camera-LiDAR calibration is an essential prerequisite for robust multi-modal perception in robotics. Recent target-less methods based on learned pixel-point correspondences achieve high extrinsic calibration accuracy and generalize across environments. However, they operate on rectified images with known camera intrinsics, restricting their applicability to systems whose cameras have already been individually calibrated. We present a fully automatic, target-less framework that jointly estimates camera intrinsics, radial-tangential distortion, and camera-LiDAR extrinsics from raw images and LiDAR scans. Our method generalizes deep correspondence-based calibration from rectified images to raw cameras through intrinsic- and distortion-aware correspondence learning via synthetic augmentations. During calibration, we iteratively couple correspondence prediction and nonlinear optimization to jointly refine the camera parameters and relative sensor transformation. We evaluate our approach on an unseen camera-LiDAR configuration from the KITTI dataset and on three real robotic platforms in a zero-shot manner. The results demonstrate that joint calibration with our generalized pixel-point correspondence network improves extrinsic accuracy over correspondence-based methods using pre-calibrated cameras, while additionally recovering accurate intrinsics.

papers.title_en: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
papers.authors: Prakhar Kaushik, Soumava Paul, Alan Yuille
papers.evidence: 以紧凑表面基元表示并重建三维场景
papers.tldr: 辐射场与点元方法推动了新视角合成和三维重建，但较高的内存与计算开销限制了实际部署。本文提出Hexels，以带一阶空间颜色场的平面六边形基元，紧凑表示局部平坦且外观平滑的区域。34个场景的内存匹配实验中，其PSNR较2DGS提升4.53–7.38 dB；DTU重建误差降低28.9%，坦克与寺庙表面平均F1达34.38%。结果表明，Hexels能改善表面基元的质量—效率权衡，并可用于二维图像表示。
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.

papers.title_en: Navigating human-robot interaction challenges in private and residential aged care homes
papers.authors: David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Mohammad Ali Armin, Akila Pemasiri, Harshala Gammulle, Tharindu Fernando, David Silvera-Tawil, Simon Denman
papers.evidence: 养老环境中的机器人交互与具身系统应用
papers.tldr: 养老机构和居家环境布局杂乱、动态多变，居民需求各异且现场技术支持有限，给老年照护中的人机交互带来突出挑战。本章回顾具身与非具身系统，讨论日常生活辅助、安全监测和社交互动，并关注机器人与固定、可穿戴传感器协同。设计需适配老年人的认知、身体和社交需求，以简易语音、清晰提示、无障碍屏幕及安全递物降低使用门槛，同时通过本地推理、数据最小化和透明授权维护隐私与信任。评估应转向误报频率、故障恢复时间、员工负担和长期可靠性，为可规模化、合规且尊重尊严的照护部署指明方向。
papers.abstract_en: This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. Although these settings differ, we frame both as extreme and challenging environments for human-robot interaction (HRI), characterised by cluttered and dynamic layouts, diverse resident needs, and limited on-site technical support. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. To ensure these technologies are usable and effective, design considerations consider the cognitive, physical, and social needs of older adults. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Privacy, trust, and acceptability are addressed via practical strategies such as on-device inference, data minimisation, visible consent controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) and privacy regulation. Evaluation emphasises real-world metrics including false alarms per day, time to recover from faults, staff workload, and long-term system reliability. We close by outlining open research challenges and future directions for scalable, regulation-ready deployments that support aging with dignity, safety, and independence.

papers.title_en: PhysCreator: Creating Physically-Attributed 3D Assets at Will
papers.authors: Shiyan Zheng, Ming Li, Lei Han, Xiangyu Xu
papers.evidence: 生成带物理属性、可用于仿真的三维资产
papers.tldr: 图像生成的三维资产虽已具备较高视觉保真度，多数却仍是静态表示，难以在动态交互中呈现可信物理行为。PhysCreator将物理属性估计纳入统一的三维表征学习，直接生成可用于模拟的资产，并以体素对齐潜在空间联合建模几何、外观与空间变化的物理属性。针对缺少密集物理标注的问题，方法通过视觉语言蒸馏，将材料语义先验转化为体素级监督，实现前馈推断。实验显示其视觉质量、物理合理性和泛化能力优于既有方法，为生成可交互、可模拟的三维内容提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Significant advancements in 3D asset creation have enabled high-fidelity 3D generation from images. However, most existing representations remain inherently static, lacking the ability to model physically plausible behaviors under dynamic interactions. We present \textbf{PhysCreator}, a unified framework that directly generates simulation-ready 3D representations with spatially varying physical properties from images. Unlike prior approaches that treat physical attributes as simple post-hoc predictions or rely on expensive per-instance optimization, we reformulate physical property estimation within a unified 3D representation learning framework. We introduce a voxel-aligned latent space by lifting image observations into a spatially structured 3D representation, in which geometry, appearance, and physical properties are jointly modeled and inferred in a feed-forward manner. To enable scalable learning without densely annotated physical ground truth, we leverage vision-language distillation to transfer material-aware semantic priors from powerful vision-language models into spatially grounded voxel-level supervision. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior visual quality, physical plausibility, and generalization compared to prior approaches.

papers.title_en: Faster Polyhedral Intersections in 3D
papers.authors: Joseph Donato, Daniel Shevitz, Rao Garimella
papers.evidence: 多面体求交是网格插值和材料界面重建的核心操作
papers.tldr: 三维多面体求交是网格插值与材料界面重建中的关键操作，通常将求交转化为用一系列平面逐步裁剪一个多面体。稳健库 R3D 已实现 Sugihara 裁剪算法，但相关计算仍有提升效率的需求。论文提出新实现 J3D，沿用 Sugihara 算法完成多面体裁剪，并报告其相较 R3D 有显著性能提升。该实现为依赖多面体求交的几何应用提供更高效的选择；摘要未披露具体加速比例。
papers.abstract_en: The operation of intersecting two polyhedra, which can be reduced to clipping one polyhedron with a series of planes formed from another polyhedron, is central to intersection based mesh interpolation and material interface reconstruction. R3D is a robust library for such operation which implements the algorithm of Sugihara. In this paper, we present J3D, a new implementation of the clipping algorithm of Sugihara that provides substantial performance improvements over R3D.

papers.title_en: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Eunbeen Hong, Hyeonseo Yu, Honggyu An, Jooho Son, Hyunah Ko, Soowon Son, Chaehyun Kim, Jahyeok Koo, Jisoo Kim, Junhwa Hur, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 前馈模型联合表征动态场景的三维结构与时间变化
papers.tldr: 四维新视角合成要在不同视点和时间重建动态场景，单目前馈方法常用显式四维高斯表示，却容易产生时间不一致与渲染伪影。FL4N提出首个前馈潜变量四维模型，将时空场景编码为统一潜表示，并在预训练静态先验上学习动态残差。轻量动态编码器利用静态特征，分离物体运动与相机视差；模型仅用图像合成目标训练。实验达到领先的合成质量并支持实时渲染，潜表示还能泛化到真实视频、区分视点与时间，为动态场景建模提供更稳健的路径。
papers.abstract_en: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

papers.title_en: Ground Sample Distance Constrained k-Coverage Viewpoint Planning via Set Multi-Cover Formulation
papers.authors: Waleed Bin Khalid, Chul Min Yeum
papers.evidence: 以表面体素和多视角覆盖规划支持无人机三维重建
papers.tldr: 无人机三维重建与结构巡检需要在满足地面采样距离等图像质量约束的同时，让每个表面区域被多次观测；仅靠图像重叠率规划难以保证这一要求。论文将视点选择建模为带逐区域覆盖需求的集合多重覆盖问题，并依据覆盖缺口和可用视点稀缺程度动态加权，贪心选择视点。实验涵盖两种结构、四种体素分辨率和三档覆盖要求，结果达到完整或近完整覆盖，视点数仅比整数线性规划多3.00%至16.39%。该方法兼顾覆盖可靠性、视点集紧凑性与选择过程可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Drone-based 3D reconstruction and inspection require viewpoints that satisfy image-quality constraints while observing each surface region multiple times, which overlap-based planning heuristics do not guarantee. We study ground sample distance (GSD)-constrained $k$-coverage viewpoint selection for structures represented by surface voxels. Candidate viewpoints are generated along outward surface directions, screened with distance, viewing-angle, field-of-view, and occlusion tests, and augmented for voxels with insufficient visibility. Selection is then posed as set multi-cover with per-voxel coverage demands. We propose a dynamically weighted greedy heuristic that prioritizes remaining coverage deficits and scarce viewing alternatives, and compare it with sequential overlap-based pruning and an integer linear programming (ILP) formulation on the same candidate pools. Across two structures, four voxel resolutions, and three coverage requirements, the proposed approach achieves full or near-full $k$-coverage with compact viewpoint sets, using only 3.00--16.39\% more viewpoints than ILP while offering an interpretable selection process based on coverage deficits and viewpoint availability.

papers.title_en: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
papers.authors: Kang He, Wenshuo Peng, Chuanhao Li, Zihui Gao, Xiaojie Xu, Zhengyuan Lin, Yuzhe Ding, Donghong Ji, Kaipeng Zhang, Yongtao Ge
papers.evidence: 面向可控交互世界模型的长时程游戏数据集
papers.tldr: 交互式世界模型能够依据动作生成动态环境，但现有模型通常难以将连贯生成维持到约一分钟，长时训练数据不足是关键瓶颈。为此，论文构建GameVerse，收录69.7K段游戏视频，共1,655小时、3.496亿帧，其中包含1,358小时连续两分钟序列。数据经场景一致分段、质量筛选和相机轨迹估计，并将静态场景信息与动态事件分开描述，按事件边界对齐标注。实验表明，使用该数据训练可显著延长交互式世界模型的生成时域，为长时可控世界建模提供数据基础。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.
